page.overview:
What is Amulet of Ti-Fu?

The Amulet of Tifu was an artifact that the Son of Carth used to contain Dakkon Blackblade's planeswalking powers, and also to cause Dakkon to die if the Son was to be killed. This curse was only to be lifted if Dakkon killed Geyadrone Dihada.
